result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_agg_degree_total()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get aggregate value from total degree of nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L14059-L14154){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_agg_degree_total(agg, conditions=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Computes a single aggregate statistic from the total degree values of all nodes. Works with both directed and undirected graphs. For directed graphs, total degree = indegree + outdegree. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [agg]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Aggregation function to apply. Must be one of: - `"sum"`: Sum of all total degrees - `"min"`: Minimum total degree - `"max"`: Maximum total degree - `"mean"`: Mean total degree - `"median"`: Median total degree [conditions]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[Callable]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Filter function that takes a node object and returns `True` to include the node in the aggregation. If `None`, all nodes are included. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The computed aggregate total degree value. Returns `0.0` if no nodes match the conditions. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `agg=` is not a valid aggregation function. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#63b56ffb .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec # Create directed graph graph = ec.Graph(directed=True) graph.add_gnm_graph(20, 35, seed=23) # Mean total degree across all nodes mean_total = graph.get_agg_degree_total('mean') # Returns 3.5 mean_total ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3.5 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#0a82be95 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Median total degree median_total = graph.get_agg_degree_total('median') # Returns 3.0 median_total ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 3.0 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#4c82a593 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Works with undirected graphs too graph_undirected = ec.Graph(directed=False) graph_undirected.add_cycle_graph(10) mean_deg = graph_undirected.get_agg_degree_total('mean') # Returns 2.0 mean_deg ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 2.0 ``` ::: :::
